title: A Novel Intercellular Communication-Associated Gene Signature for Prognostic Prediction and Clinical Value in Patients With Lung Adenocarcinoma
summary: Multi-dataset machine-learning and intercellular-communication analysis identified lung-adenocarcinoma genes associated with prognosis and immune-cell signaling; these remain candidate associations.
